medicalSpecialist.description: I am a urologist certified by the Philippine Board of Urology practicing in Davao City. I was trained in the National Kidney and Transplant Institute, the premier training institution in the field of Urology. I am an expert in minimally invasive and laparoscopic urologic surgeries as well as transplant urology. I treat diseases , tumors and stones of the KIDNEYS, URETER, URINARY BLADDER, PROSTATE and ADRENALS as well as disorders and problems of the MALE GENITALIA, TESTIS and SCROTUM.

Dr. Danzon John de Castro was born and raised in Butuan City, Agusan del Norte. He earned his bachelor's degree in Nutrition and Dietetics from Silliman University and his Doctor of Medicine degree from Southwestern University Matias H. Aznar Memorial College of Medicine. He is a licensed physician and a registered nutritionist-dietitian. His professional interests include head and neck oncology, free flap reconstruction, nutritional biochemistry, medical nutrition therapy, and surgical innovation.
